title: Shift of joined fields
statement: For lists $u,v,fs$ of symbols and an integer $z\ge -1$, the symbol stored at position $|u|+1+z$ in the tape formed by joining $u,v$, and the fields in $fs$ equals the symbol stored at position $z$ in the tape formed by joining $v$ and the fields in $fs$.
hypotheses_covered: u and v are lists over Γ
fs is a list of lists over Γ
z is an integer at least −1
